source_criterion: For zero-field nearest-neighbour Ising on Z^3, beta<beta_c, U4 is the connected four-point function, chi(beta)=sum_x <sigma_0 sigma_x>, and xi(beta)=[lim_n -(1/n)log<sigma_0 sigma_{n e1}>]^{-1}. The source defines g(beta)=sum_{x2,x3,x4}U4(0,x2,x3,x4)/(chi(beta)^2 xi(beta)^3). Nontrivial means g(beta) does not tend to 0 as beta increases to beta_c; equivalently, since U4<=0, limsup[-g(beta)]>0. This is a near-critical criterion, not an assertion about every critical finite-volume spin-field limit.
